shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && find .agents -type f | head -100 && echo ---- && ls -la && cat AGENTS.md | head -100

cat package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore && find src -type f | xargs ls -la && for f in $(find src -type f); do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; echo; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -150

grep -n -i -A12 "i18n" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -60

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json | head -60; echo ----; grep -n '"node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n"' -A12 package-lock.json; grep -n -B2 -A10 '"node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit"' package-lock.json | head -60; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/README.md | head -150; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep -n -A3 '"exports"' | head; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -maxdepth 3 -iname "*doc*" | head; grep -rn "configure" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.js; echo ----; grep -rn "Lang\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/lang.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -rln "export type Lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | head; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/ | head -80; grep -rn "ThemeProvider" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -rn "lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/*/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useLang.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo ----; timeout 20 curl -sS -o /tmp/uikit-llms.txt -w "%{http_code}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt; wc -c /tmp/uikit-llms.txt 2>/dev/null

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js | head -80; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useLang.js; echo ----; grep -rn "Segmented\|RadioButton" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/; echo ----; grep -rln "addComponentKeysets" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -20; echo ----; grep -rn "addComponentKeysets" -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -20

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Alert/i18n/index.js; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Alert/i18n/*.json 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Alert/i18n/; echo ----; grep -n "ControlGroupOption\b" -A8 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; grep -rn "\bt(\|useTranslation\|label_" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Alert/Alert.js | head -5; npm config get registry; timeout 30 npm view @gravity-ui/i18n@1.8.0 version 2>&1 | tail -2

cp package.json /tmp/pkg.before.json && cp package-lock.json /tmp/lock.before.json && npm install @gravity-ui/i18n@^1.8.0 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -5; git diff --no-index --stat /tmp/pkg.before.json package.json; diff /tmp/pkg.before.json package.json; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/en.json 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/ | head -30

git diff --no-index --stat /tmp/lock.before.json package-lock.json | tail -1; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/types.d.ts | head -40; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; grep -rn "export interface FlexProps\|export interface TextProps" -A12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -50

sed -n 22,32p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; grep -n "Text.*variant\|color" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/; grep -rn "Subheader\|secondary" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -3
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -40
